name: hypromellose 2208 (100 mpa.s)
purpose: Use For use as a lubricant to prevent further irritation or to relieve dryness of the eye.
uses: Uses for use as a lubricant to prevent further irritation to relieve dryness of the eye
otcwarn: Do not use if this product changes color or becomes cloudy if you are sensitive to any ingredient in this product Stop use and consult a physician if you experience any of the following: eye pain changes in vision occur irritation or redness for longer than 72 hours
